evidence.text: Vanguard Charters recorded an on-time delivery rate of 96 percent this year.
Vanguard Charters maintains a fleet size of 12 freighters.
Meridian Express maintains a fleet size of 50 refrigerated trucks.
Vanguard Charters holds cargo liability insurance of $5,000,000.
Vanguard Charters holds a Global Charter Operations License.
Atlas Marine holds a Certified Freight Forwarder license.

memories.text: Vanguard Charters is selected for the priority cargo dispatch.
Vanguard Charters meets elite carrier endorsement criteria.
Atlas Marine is approved for international ocean dispatch.
Vanguard Charters holds verified airlift vendor status.
Meridian Express fulfills baseline cold-chain transport standards.

updates.text: An unverified regulatory post claims Vanguard Charters might not possess a Global Charter Operations License.

policies.text: A haulage provider meets low-temperature distribution requirements provided its fleet size contains no fewer than 30 refrigerated trucks.
An organization receives a primary transport contract when accredited as an elite carrier while carrying cargo liability insurance of at least $3,000,000.
A rail operator qualifies for regional rail privileges if it maintains a track safety rating of 95 percent or higher.
An enterprise earns approval as an elite carrier provided it is designated as an accredited air transport provider and achieves a yearly on-time delivery rate of 90 percent or higher.
A cargo enterprise qualifies as an accredited air transport provider if it possesses a Global Charter Operations License, or if its fleet size reaches at least 10 freighters.
An agency receives a customs clearance waiver provided its yearly import volume exceeds 50,000 metric tons.
A shipping company obtains authorization for global sea freight when it possesses a Certified Freight Forwarder license.
